data.title: Meet ‘Gigi’, the bus driver armed with a megaphone
data.description: Thitipha Khongming, or Gigi as she prefers to be called, has become one of Thailand's most recognisable bus drivers, thanks to a megaphone and a strong determination to clear Bangkok bus stops of obstructing vehicles.

data.title: Japan drops case against Thai woman in ‘ice’ smuggling probe
data.description: Japanese prosecutors have decided not to indict a 28-year-old Thai woman arrested after 900 grammes of crystal methamphetamine was found hidden inside coffee sachets she carried into Japan, concluding she had no apparent intent or prior links to an international drug-trafficking network, the Office of the Narcotics Control Board said on Friday.

data.title: What Is Post-Acute Withdrawal Syndrome for Alcohol (PAWS)?
data.description: Post-acute withdrawal syndrome can bring lingering sleep problems, anxiety, fatigue and brain fog after alcohol detox as the brain continues to recover.

data.title: Huawei Cloud Unveils Agentic Infrastructure and CodeArts Agent OBT in Thailand
data.description: Huawei Cloud has hosted Huawei Cloud Summit Thailand 2026, bringing together leaders from government, business, industry partners, and the technology community to exchange views on how cloud and AI can support Thailand’s digital economy. During the event, Huawei Cloud announced “Huawei Cloud Agentic Infrastructure: Now Available for Thailand” and officially launched Huawei Cloud CodeArts Agent Open Beta Testing (OBT) in the country.

data.title: Fifa vows to go ahead with private investor proposal
data.description: PARIS — World football's governing bodyFédération Internationale de Football Association (Fifa) vowed on Friday to press ahead with an "open and democratic" consultation on a proposed private investment plan despite widespread opposition to the proposal.

data.title: Truck seized for dumping industrial waste on private Sa Kaeo land
data.description: SA KAEO — Authorities in Sa Kaeo have seized a 22-wheel truck carrying industrial waste after it was allegedly caught dumping hazardous material on private land in Watthana Nakhon district.

data.title: Indian creator highlights four unexpected sides of Thailand
data.description: Indian content creator Shreya Mahendru lists four culture shocks in Thailand, from women’s role at work to temple rules, nightlife, and dress freedom.

data.title: Most Australian teens still on social media three months after ban
data.description: SYDNEY — More ‌than eight in 10 Australian teenagers were still using social media three months after the government's landmark ban on the platforms for under-16s took effect because the tech firms failed to implement effective age checks, the country's internet regulator has found.

data.title: Your weekly horoscope for July 31 - Aug 6
data.description: Your spot-on weekly horoscope for work, money and relationship from Guru by the Bangkok Post's famously accurate fortune teller. Let's see how you will fare this week and beyond.

data.title: More than 1.8 million speed pills uncovered in Suphan Buri
data.description: Police have seized 1.84 million speed pills worth about 10 million baht from a rented house in Don Chedi district of Suphan Buri, following an investigation that began with the arrest of a drug user found carrying 10 speed pills.

data.title: Renowned Nepali climber among 10 missing after Pakistan avalanche
data.description: ISLAMABAD (PAKISTAN) - Renowned Nepali mountaineer Nirmal Purja is among 10 people missing after an avalanche in northern Pakistan where they were on a climbing expedition, the country's alpine club said.

data.title: Explosion at coal mine kills 34 in southern Pakistan
data.description: QUETTA (PAKISTAN) - A blast at a coal mine killed at least 34 workers in southern Pakistan, the provincial disaster agency said on Friday, as rescuers searched for more missing miners.

data.title: The last trio: S.Africa's zoo elephants await their fate
data.description: JOHANNESBURG - The last three elephants still in a traditional South African zoo entered their enclosure in single file, fruit and vegetables scattered on the ground to encourage natural foraging.

data.title: Mae Sai red-flagged on possible flash floods
data.description: Residents living near the Sai River in Mai Sai district have been advised to closely monitor the water level and wait for signals from authorities to move the eldery and patients to higher ground as rains could possibly trigger flash floods.

data.title: 41 Thais repatriated from Laos
data.description: Forty-one Thai nationals accused of working for an online gambling ring in Laos have been repatriated after legal proceedings there ended and are now being screened by Thai authorities.

data.title: Sompo to cover cost of bringing Hlun Solo's body home
data.description: Sompo Insurance (Thailand) has pledged to cover, in full, the cost of repatriating the body of travel YouTuber Bowornthat Pengsuk, known as Hlun Solo, who died in Georgia at the age of 27.

data.title: South peace efforts face new hurdle
data.description: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul declined to comment on the postponement of peace talks with the Barisan Revolusi Nasional (BRN), saying the sensitive issue should be handled by officials directly responsible.

data.title: Drug case decision due
data.description: Japanese prosecutors are expected to decide today whether to indict a Thai woman arrested at Fukuoka Airport with 900 grammes of crystal meth hidden in coffee sachets.

data.title: Ferrand-Prevot bids to defend Tour de France Femmes title
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - Pauline Ferrand-Prevot begins the Tour de France Femmes this weekend determined to repeat last year's triumph, but the Frenchwoman faces a tough challenge in a field headed by in-form Dutch rival Demi Vollering.

data.title: Weed-clearing ops target 'sex cruising' site
data.description: Pathum Thani: The Department of Rural Roads (DRR) has cleared overgrown vegetation around a concrete barrier storage site in Muang district after reports emerged claiming the area had become a gathering spot for sexual activity, with numerous used condoms found scattered across the site.

data.title: Ubon airport welcomes record traffic
data.description: Ubon Ratchathani Airport handled a record number of passengers during the long holiday period, as visitors flocked to the province for its renowned annual candle festival.

data.title: Floods despite low rainfall prompt dredging order
data.description: Localised flooding despite below-average rainfall has prompted the Office of the National Water Resources (ONWR) to order the relevant agencies to clear waterways and inspect construction sites.

data.title: RDS opposes healthcare law changes
data.description: The Rural Doctors Society (RDS) has vowed to oppose proposed amendments to the National Health Security Act, warning they could weaken patients' rights and give bureaucrats greater control over Thailand's universal healthcare scheme.

data.title: Chiang Rai workers duped by Ireland fake job scam
data.description: The Ministry of Labour is investigating an alleged overseas employment scam after more than 20 Chiang Rai job seekers claimed they were duped into paying hundreds of thousands of baht for fake jobs in Ireland.

data.title: CP LAND launches ‘Pri-d’ to empower residents and partners.
data.description: C .P.LAND Public Company Limited, Thailand's leading property developers under the Charoen Pokphand (C.P) Group, has launched the Pri-d Privilege Programme, a customer relationship management (CRM) platform designed to connect residents, customers, businesspartnersand services within a single ecosystem.

data.title: Opposition accused of pressuring agency
data.description: A senior lawmaker has accused opposition parties of attempting to pressure the Election Commission (EC) over an ongoing investigation into alleged collusion in last year's Senate election and pressed for a probe into the hiring of aides by some senators.

data.title: High stakes, low payoff
data.description: A woman is forced back into a life of crime after being double-crossed by the person she loves most in Apple TV's new thriller series Lucky.

data.title: US government map of Africa mislabels every country at global conference
data.description: DAKAR — A US government map of Africa mislabelled every country during a State Department presentation at a global conference taking place in Brazil this week, causing a stir among attendees who took screenshots and posted them online.

data.title: A taste of Ningbo and Chaozhou
data.description: With it being recently reported that China is the top overseas destination for Thai travellers, it is time to get to know the cuisine better.

data.title: BEM Reports 60% EMV Contactless Growth, Backs Govt Common Ticketing System
data.description: BEM has announced a significant increase in the adoption of EMV Contactless payments, with usage rising by 60% following the full implementation of EMV payment acceptance across the MRT Blue Line and Purple Line. The company reaffirmed its readiness to support the Government’s Common Ticketing Policy and the upcoming 17–45 baht integrated fare scheme, while continuing to work closely with the Mass Rapid Transit Authority of Thailand (MRTA) and Krungthai Bank to further enhance the system’s efficiency and service standards.

data.title: Field of 10 confirmed in SAT chief race
data.description: The Sports Authority of Thailand (SAT) has closed applications for the position of Governor, with the field settling at 10 candidates after Dr Mallika Boonmeetrakul Mahasuk submitted her application on the final day.

data.title: Fresh faces headline Thais 2026 SEA V Cup campaign
data.description: Thailand will face Indonesia in the opening match of the 2026 SEA V Cup (formerly known as the SEA V League) first leg at Hanoi's Dong Anh Gymnasium today, while hosts Vietnam will play the Philippines.

data.title: Thailand Privilege Visa 2026: What the latest promotions mean for long-term residents
data.description: As Thailand enters the third quarter of 2026, several Thailand Privilege promotions are approaching key deadlines as the country’s long-stay landscape continues to evolve. With visa policies and residence options changing, foreign residents are increasingly looking for longer-term solutions that offer greater stability, flexibility and predictability when planning their future in Thailand.

data.title: Of pharaohs and fantasy
data.description: More or less, Van Cleef & Arpels discusses Egyptology through its exquisite haute joaillerie.

data.title: Palmyre pieces are fit for a queen
data.description: With fewer tiers, the new Palmyre Parures can be worn on any occasion.

data.title: ONE Championship: Ghazali, Ondash trade shoves after smooth Inner Circle 24 weigh-ins
data.description: Johan Ghazali and Ramadan Ondash had to be separated after another fiery ONE Championship face-off at Lumpinee Stadium on Thursday – but there were no surprises on the scales ahead of The Inner Circle 24.

data.title: ONE Championship: Rodtang retracts forgery claims, apologises to Chatri as bitter saga nears end
data.description: Rodtang Jitmuangnon has withdrawn his allegations that employees of ONE Championship forged his signature and issued a sweeping apology to chairman and CEO Chatri Sityodtong – apparently drawing a line under one of the most bitter disputes in the promotion’s history.
